cells.gaps: Sources disagree: the ministry says the deeds registers are computerised and updated daily, while the Registrar of Deeds spoke in 2025 of upgrading manual registration to a fully electronic system. No source in the last three years says the land system joins records with survey maps or valuation.
cells.note: The Deeds Registry's land registers are computerised and updated as ownership changes hands, per the ministry in 2026, so stage 3, though deeds are still lodged by hand.
